verdicts.target: T-MPC++ (de Groot et al. 2024, IEEE T-RO) "Topology-Driven Parallel Trajectory Optimization in Dynamic Environments" — vs STRIDE residuals S2, S3, S5 (and FULCRUM by extension)
verdicts.prior_art_summary: T-MPC++/T-MPC (de Groot, Ferranti, Gavrila, Alonso-Mora; arXiv:2401.06021, T-RO 2024 vol.41 pp.110-126) is the canonical topology-driven parallel planner in DYNAMIC pedestrian environments. Confirmed mechanics: (a) Topology classes defined in the dynamic, TIME-INCLUSIVE collision-free space X:=R^2×[0,T], with obstacle set unioned over time — i.e. genuine spatiotemporal homotopy/passing-side, exactly the "winding class" notion. Classes distinguished via H-signature (loop-encircles-moving-obstacle test) and winding numbers (relative robot-obstacle angle), with UVD for 3D. (b) Enumeration via a Visibility-PRM sampling-based guidance planner producing homotopy-distinct guidance trajectories. (c) P low-level local planners (MPC) run in PARALLEL, each locked to one homotopy class, initialized from a distinct guidance trajectory. (d) Executed trajectory chosen by argmin_i J_i* (lowest cost), with an optional consistency weight c_i favoring the previous class. (e) Theorem 1 gives Homotopy-Globally-Optimal optimality ONLY under conditions (enumeration completeness etc.); Theorem 2 guarantees non-degradation vs unguided MPC when an unguided planner is included. CRUCIALLY ABSENT: no conformal prediction, no probabilistic chance constraints, no per-agent risk budget/allocation, no Lagrangian/dual price as a topology selector (selection is pure min-cost), no Hessian/KKT inertia reading for routing or failure typing, no (time,risk) Pareto stairway, no min-risk full-function/recovery-class semantics. Gaussian-uncertainty handling is only referenced (ref [4]), not developed here.
verdicts.closest_overlap: S2 most threatened: T-MPC already does spatiotemporal winding/H-signature topology-class enumeration over moving pedestrians + parallel per-class optimization + select-one execution — the entire "winding-class enumeration & parallel full-function planner" scaffolding STRIDE leans on. S3 partially overlapped: T-MPC's architecture already separates enumeration-completeness (affects only optimality/HGO, Thm 1/2) from per-class feasibility constraints (each MPC carries its own collision constraints) — the "incompleteness loses optimality, not safety" decoupling is structurally present.
verdicts.what_survives: T-MPC kills STRIDE's unstated scaffolding (spatiotemporal winding-class enumeration + parallel per-class MPC + min-cost selection over moving pedestrians is fully prior art — do NOT claim any of that as novel). But the load-bearing residuals survive: S2's actual claim is NOT enumerate-and-pick-min-cost; it is the DUAL PRICE λ as a single mechanism that simultaneously reallocates per-agent conformal budget AND selects the winding class, with certified λ_k breakpoints = give-way/take-way switches yielding a native (time, certified-risk) Pareto STAIRWAY. T-MPC selects by scalar min-cost J_i*, has no dual variable acting as selector, no budget, no Pareto front — so the price-as-topological-selector-with-certified-breakpoints is uncolllided and is the strongest survivor. S3 survives in content: T-MPC has NO conformal-tube + Bernstein-hull POST-HOC certified risk bound on the executed quintic; its "safety" is deterministic collision constraints, not P(collision)≤ε with distribution-free calibration — so the certified-risk-decoupled-from-enumeration claim survives even though the bare decoupling idea is anticipated (downgrade S3's framing to "we add a probabilistic certificate to a known decoupling," not "we invented the decoupling"). S5 fully survives: T-MPC reads no Hessian/KKT inertia at all; reduced-Hessian λ_min as a cross-layer stuck-type router (numerical-saddle vs topology-stuck vs dynamically-infeasible) is untouched. FULCRUM F1-F4 (O(M) matrix-free reduced-Hessian Hvp, inertia routing, FLÈCHE root-enumeration cell-infeasibility, quintic-Bernstein HOCBF forward-invariance) are entirely outside T-MPC's scope. Net: STRIDE must drop novelty claims on topology+parallel+dynamic enumeration, but conformal-quantile-as-tradable-resource (S1/S2 price), certified risk on executed path (S3), and inertia routing (S5) remain genuinely new vs this strongest competitor.

verdicts.target: S1 (conformal quantile as tradeable dual resource welded to the main-line ε certificate; α_i-indexed distribution-free tube radius r=Q_{1-α}; λ unit = makespan/unit-quantile; planner objective IS the certificate). Secondary: S3.
verdicts.prior_art_summary: arXiv 2511.18170 "Time-aware Motion Planning in Dynamic Environments with Conformal Prediction" (2025-11-22) presents two planners. CP-SIPP extends Safe Interval Path Planning by "incorporating discrete confidence levels derived from conformal prediction": it makes safe intervals CONFIDENCE-INDEXED (scales/expands SIPP states by a discrete grid of CP confidence levels, i.e. the obstacle inflation radius is the conformal quantile r=Q_{1-α} at level α), and computes time-optimal trajectories under distribution-free finite-sample safety guarantees. Crucially it lets "path risk be explicitly weighted against travel time within the cost function" (a time-vs-risk tradeoff scalar) and adds an "adaptive quantile mechanism" that "tunes THE confidence level automatically to the optimal value that preserves trajectory feasibility" — i.e. it picks the conformal quantile that trades safety margin against makespan. ACP-RRT extends this to continuous domains with online-adaptive safety bounds. Guarantee = distribution-free CP coverage on predicted obstacle motion. No homotopy/winding-class enumeration, no Bernstein/quintic continuous-time hull, no per-agent distinct budget allocation, no Lagrangian dual price exposed, no Pareto staircase output (it converges to one optimal confidence level / one trajectory).
verdicts.closest_overlap: Hits S1's CORE mechanism: (a) conformal quantile r=Q_{1-α} as the indexed risk knob (confidence-indexed safe intervals = α-indexed tube radius), and (b) trading that quantile against makespan inside the planner objective ("path risk weighted against travel time" + "adaptive quantile tunes confidence to optimal feasibility"). That is essentially S1's "conformal quantile as the tradeable resource against makespan, planner objective ≈ certificate." Does NOT touch S3: no winding enumeration, no Bernstein-hull post-hoc certificate on a chosen quintic, no safety-vs-enumeration-completeness decoupling.
verdicts.what_survives: After removing this prior art, what survives of S1: (1) PER-AGENT tradeable budget — α_i indexed by individual agent with reallocation across agents; the paper uses a single GLOBAL confidence level tuned scalar-wise (singular "the confidence level"), not a per-pedestrian budget vector. (2) λ as an explicit DUAL PRICE with units "makespan/unit conformal quantile" producing a certified continuum with breakpoints — the paper uses a fixed cost weight + greedy adaptive tuning to one feasible value, not a priced dual variable. (3) Welding to the multi-branch safety-layer ε certificate (ε_cls+ε_pred, Mondrian class×density strata, human→hard constraint, occlusion shadow, unrecognized-FN gate) — the paper is generic single-stream CP coverage. S3 survives almost intact (CLEAR vs this paper): SIPP graph search has no homotopy enumeration and no quintic+Bernstein-hull continuous-time certificate, so the "safety/optimality decoupled from winding-enumeration completeness; incomplete enumeration costs only anytime gap" claim is untouched. Net: S1's headline ("conformal quantile traded against makespan in the objective, adaptively chosen") is substantially anticipated; only the per-agent-budget + dual-price-λ + multi-branch-certificate welding remain genuinely new. S3 is clear.

verdicts.target: Mavrogiannis and Knepper space-time braids / topological multi-agent navigation line (incl. Winding Through, RA-L 2023) vs STRIDE residuals S2, S3
verdicts.closest_overlap: S2: the winding-number/braid as the topological selector primitive, plus using a scalar lambda to weight a tradeoff and (in the braids papers) to enumerate and select topological classes. This is exactly the primitive STRIDE leans on, so it must be cited. S3: Winding Through advertises a decoupling (topological passing decoupled from collision avoidance) that superficially echoes S3 decoupling language; and the braids papers do enumerate topological classes.
verdicts.prior_art_summary: This line OWNS the winding/braid primitive for navigation and must be cited. (1) Mavrogiannis and Knepper, Multi-agent path topology (IJRR 2018/2019) and Decentralized Multi-Agent Navigation Planning with Braids (WAFR 2016/2020): full multi-agent, non-communicating, game-theoretic; model joint strategies as equivalence classes of topological braids, ENUMERATE braid/homotopy classes, select via a cost weighted by a scalar lambda trading personal efficiency vs consensus/entropy-reduction over the joint-strategy belief. (2) Winding Through: Crowd Navigation via Topological Invariance (RA-L 2023): SINGLE ego robot among n agents that are NOT reactive (constant-velocity prediction; robot does not know their policy/goal). Defines pairwise winding number lambda_i=(1/2pi)sum Delta-theta as topological invariant capturing passing progress (magnitude) and side (sign); uses it as a COST term inside MPC over a candidate-trajectory pool. States the topological passing formalism is decoupled from collision avoidance, handled by a personal-space cost. CRITICALLY across the line: NO conformal prediction, NO risk budget, NO dual/Lagrangian price, NO probabilistic per-agent safety certificate, NO certified breakpoints, NO (time,risk) Pareto frontier. No paper of theirs combines winding with conformal risk/dual pricing.
verdicts.what_survives: The winding/braid PRIMITIVE collides (it is theirs; STRIDE must cite this line and cannot claim winding-class selection for navigation as novel). S2 survives: their lambda is a fixed taste-weight (efficiency vs consensus) or a plain cost coefficient, NOT a tradeable dual on a conformal risk budget. They have no mechanism where one price simultaneously (a) reallocates per-agent conformal-quantile budget and (b) flips the winding class at CERTIFIED breakpoints lambda_k, and no native (time, certified-risk) Pareto staircase; the budget-reallocation==topology-flip coupling is absent. S3 survives: their decoupling is topology-vs-collision-avoidance, not safety-vs-enumeration-completeness; they have NO formal safety certificate (no conformal tube, no Bernstein convex-hull bound on the executed quintic), so no guarantee that incomplete enumeration only loses anytime gap and never safety. STRIDE per-path certified-risk provably independent of enumeration count is new vs this line. Caveat: S3 conformal-tube safety overlaps the broader conformal-prediction-for-crowd-nav literature (Interaction-aware CP arXiv:2502.06221; Conformal Risk Control HRI arXiv:2603.10392), a separate collision axis, not Mavrogiannis/Knepper.

verdicts.target: [paper] Iterative Risk Allocation (Ono & Williams 2008) + Blackmore/Ono chance-constrained path planning + arXiv 2302.13115 dual CC-SSP — threatens residuals S1, S2
verdicts.prior_art_summary: IRA (Ono & Williams, CDC 2008) is the direct ancestor of S1's core mechanism: it decomposes a JOINT chance constraint into per-constraint individual chance constraints via Boole/union bound, treats the per-constraint risk bounds δ_i as ALLOCATABLE budget summing to Δ, and JOINTLY optimizes the allocation (upper stage, gradient/descent on risk margins using active-vs-inactive constraint sensitivities — effectively a dual/sensitivity reallocation) with the control sequence (lower stage, MILP path generation). So "allocate the risk/chance budget across obstacles/constraints and co-optimize with the planner, using a sensitivity (≈dual price) signal to move budget from satisfied to tight constraints" is EXACTLY done in 2008. Key limits of this prior: (1) it is GAUSSIAN — the per-constraint risk maps to a probability mass via the Gaussian CDF / inverse-CDF margin, not a distribution-free calibrated quantile; the risk allocation is over chance-constraint probability mass, not a conformal tube radius r_i=Q_{1-α_i}. (2) Risk allocation and the discrete left/right-of-obstacle choice are SEPARATE: the side selection lives in the MILP big-M binaries, NOT driven by the risk price; there is no single λ that simultaneously reallocates budget and flips a homotopy/winding class, and no certified (time, risk) Pareto staircase from sweeping a price. Dual CC-SSP (Alyassi & Khonji, arXiv 2302.13115, 2023) gives an exact ILP + a DUAL/LP formulation over a discrete (C-SSP/MDP) model with randomized rounding for stochastic policies; constrained-MDP duality does yield a risk-price→discrete-policy-switch at breakpoints and a cost/risk Pareto frontier — but over discrete MDP policies/routes, not continuous spacetime winding classes, not conformal, and not coupled to per-agent conformal budget reallocation. Adjacent: Lindemann 2023 (conformal safe planning) splits failure prob across agents/time by a FIXED union bound (not optimized/traded); 2507.11920 embeds per-predictor conformal radii in a chance-constrained MPC but allocates COMPUTE, not the α budget.
verdicts.closest_overlap: S1 most directly. IRA already = "treat per-constraint risk bound as an allocatable budget, reallocate it via a sensitivity/dual signal, co-optimize with the planner." The 'risk allocation as a tradeable resource welded to the planner objective' backbone is squarely IRA. S2 is partially overlapped via constrained-MDP/dual CC-SSP duality, which independently shows a risk price producing discrete policy switching + a cost/risk Pareto frontier.
verdicts.what_survives: After stripping IRA + dual CC-SSP, the surviving genuinely-new deltas: (1) S1's distribution-free instantiation — the tradeable resource is a CONFORMAL quantile (α_i indexes a calibrated tube radius r_i=Q_{1-α_i}, index-distribution-free), so λ's unit is literally 'makespan per unit conformal quantile' rather than Gaussian probability mass; IRA cannot say this (Gaussian) and conformal-allocation prior (Lindemann) uses a FIXED union-bound split, not an optimized traded budget. (2) S2's UNIFICATION — a SINGLE dual price λ that simultaneously (a) reallocates per-agent conformal budget AND (b) selects the spacetime WINDING/homotopy class, with the λ_k breakpoints emitted as a certified (time, certified-risk) Pareto staircase, inside a CONTINUOUS full-function quintic planner. IRA keeps allocation and side-choice in separate stages (no winding coupling); dual CC-SSP's price→switch is over discrete MDP policies, not continuous winding, and not conformal. (3) The 'planner objective IS the ε safety certificate' framing on tracker-output-calibrated conformal tubes. CAVEAT (honesty): the bare idea 'dual/Lagrange price → discrete maneuver switch at breakpoints + Pareto frontier' is NOT novel on its own — constrained-MDP duality (incl. 2302.13115) and Lagrangian sensitivity already give it; S2's novelty rests entirely on the conformal + budget-reallocation-equals-topology-flip unification, which must be defended sharply or it reads as a re-skin of IRA's two-stage + constrained-MDP duality.

verdicts.target: ST-GCS (arXiv 2503.00583) + GCS* (2407.08848) + INSATxGCS/IxG* (2410.08909) + ST-RRT* (2203.02176) — spatio-temporal global-optimal / anytime / gap-certificate planning
verdicts.prior_art_summary:
这条 GCS/RRT* 谱系把"时空全局最优 + anytime + 间隙下界"做得很彻底,但全部针对 cost/time 目标,不涉及风险定价:
(1) GCS 基座 (Marcucci et al., Science Robotics 2023 / arXiv 2205.04422):把 MICP 的整数约束松弛得到凸规划,该松弛是原问题最优值的 LOWER BOUND;并"自动给出所设计轨迹代价与 MICP 最优值之差的紧界"——即认证的最优性间隙/次优证书;当 rounding 路径代价==松弛代价即证明全局最优,可提前停。这正是"全局间隙下界 + 间隙证书"。
(2) GCS* (2407.08848):A* 推广到隐式 GCS,cost-optimal + complete,并给出"complete but suboptimal"变体;另有 ICAPS "A* for Bounding Shortest Paths in GCS" 显式做下界。
(3) INSATxGCS / IxG* (2410.08909):anytime,IxG* "可预先指定解的次优界",比 GCS 更强的完备/最优保证。
(4) ST-GCS (2503.00583):把 GCS 扩到时间维,统一凸优化求 time-optimal 时空轨迹,multi-robot,带 Exact Convex Decomposition 把已定轨迹当时空障碍预留。
(5) ST-RRT* (2203.02176):时空双向、概率完备、对到达时间渐近最优的 anytime 规划器(OMPL 已收录)。
此外时空 homotopy-class 枚举(TRUST-Planner 等维护按时空同伦类分支的优先队列;两阶段先全局选同伦类再局部最优)在自动驾驶规划里是成熟做法——但都绑在 cost/time,不是 conformal-quantile 风险对偶价。
verdicts.closest_overlap: 威胁 S2(已降级)与 REGENT-lineage 的"anytime/连续统下界/间隙证书"侧。最近撞点:GCS 凸松弛本身就是全局间隙 LOWER BOUND + 自带紧的最优性间隙证书;GCS*/IxG* 提供 anytime + 可预指定次优界;ST-GCS 提供时空全局 time-optimal;ST-RRT* 提供时空 anytime 渐近最优。所以"时空全局最优 / anytime / 认证间隙下界"这一组只要 STRIDE 宣称即正面撞 GCS 谱系。
verdicts.what_survives: 边界画对了,降级是必要的:任何"时空全局最优 / anytime / 认证间隙下界"的新颖性声称都会硬撞 GCS 松弛间隙证书 + ST-RRT*/GCS*/IxG* 的 anytime+次优界,STRIDE 必须显式让出这块(只能当工程载体引用,不能当 contribution)。剥掉这条谱系后真正存活的 S2 残差是它们完全没碰的东西:(a) 对偶资源是 conformal QUANTILE / 认证语义风险预算(ε_cls+ε_pred),不是 cost/time——GCS 谱系的 LP 对偶是流量/边指示变量,跟分布无关风险半径 r_i=Q_{1-α_i} 无关;(b) 单一价格 λ(单位=makespan/单位 conformal quantile)同时既在 per-agent 间重分配风险预算、又翻转时空 winding/拓扑类,且断点 λ_k 是被"认证"的抢行vs让行切换,输出 (时间, 认证风险) 的 Pareto 阶梯——GCS 谱系是单目标(time 或 cost)+ 单一次优界,homotopy 枚举与预算重分配在它们那里是两套机制且无风险定价语义。结论:连续统/间隙下界的"时间/代价"版已被做尽(不可作卖点);"风险定价 + 认证拓扑翻转断点 + 风险-时间 Pareto 阶梯"是清白残差。

verdicts.target: Wächter & Biegler IPOPT inertia-controlling factorization / KKT-inertia use in interior-point & SQP — regularizer vs router? (threatens S5, F1)
verdicts.prior_art_summary: The optimization literature already uses KKT-matrix inertia in BOTH ways the candidates try to oppose — not only as a regularizer but explicitly as a diagnostic that routes to structurally different actions. (1) Regularizer use: Wächter & Biegler's IPOPT (Math. Prog. 2006) factorizes the augmented KKT system, reads its inertia (n+, m-, 0), and if it's wrong adds δ_w I to the Hessian block (and δ_c I to constraints) — classic inertia correction = "add δI to guarantee descent." (2) Router/diagnostic use, also pre-existing: when the correct inertia CANNOT be achieved even after regularization, IPOPT aborts the step and switches to a different algorithm — the feasibility-restoration phase that minimizes constraint violation with a different objective. That is a diagnostic→structurally-different-recovery route keyed on inertia. Beyond IPOPT, modified-Newton / augmented-Lagrangian-with-directions-of-negative-curvature methods (Moré–Sorensen; Forsgren; Gould et al.) use the inertia-controlling/Bunch-Parlett factorization specifically to EXTRACT a negative-curvature escape direction and line-search along it — diagnosis of indefiniteness → escape step. "Landscape-aware" second-order methods route among gradient / negative-curvature / regularized-Newton step types based on the curvature/inertia at the iterate. IPOPT even ships an inertia-FREE alternative (neg_curv_test_tol) framing inertia purely as a curvature diagnostic. Separately, topology-driven trajectory optimization (de Groot/Alonso-Mora, T-RO 2024, arXiv:2401.06021) handles getting-stuck by enumerating/optimizing homotopy(winding) classes in parallel — but it does NOT gate this on the solver's reduced-Hessian spectrum.
verdicts.closest_overlap: S5 and F1: "reduced-Hessian inertia / λ_min as a router that classifies WHY the solve is stuck and dispatches structurally different recovery." Overlap is on the core meta-claim "inertia is read as a router/diagnostic, not just a δI regularizer" — that exact dichotomy is already resolved against novelty: IPOPT's feasibility-restoration trigger (inertia uncorrectable → switch objective) and negative-curvature-direction methods (inertia → escape step) are spectrum-driven routing to different action types.
verdicts.what_survives: The sharp framing in S5/F1 ("they only regularize/CORRECT with δI; we are the first to READ the spectrum to arbitrate branches") is refuted — spectrum/inertia-as-router is established prior art (negative-curvature escape steps; IPOPT feasibility-restoration trigger; landscape-aware step routing). What genuinely survives is narrower: the SPECIFIC cross-layer, planner-SEMANTIC routing — using the reduced-Hessian spectrum to classify into {numerical saddle / this-winding-class topologically-hard / dynamics-infeasible} and dispatch to discrete PLANNING-layer alternatives {escape direction / flip homotopy-winding class / re-time the trajectory}. The optimizer literature routes only WITHIN one continuous solve (regularize / neg-curv step / restore feasibility); it never escalates to "switch homotopy class" or "re-allocate segment times" as the recovery, and topology-parallel planners that DO switch winding classes don't gate on the spectrum. So the residual is an application-level instantiation: mapping an established meta-pattern (spectrum→action-type router) onto discrete topological+temporal planner recoveries, plus the O(M) matrix-free reduced-Hessian construction (F2) that makes per-cell spectrum reads cheap — F2 is untouched by this prior. This is a modest, defensible residual, not a clean new mechanism; it must be claimed as "novel routing TARGETS/semantics," never "first to use inertia as a router."

verdicts.target: F2/S5: 求解器级二阶 MINCO —— 对平坦消元后的 (q,T) 缩并问题做 reduced-Hessian Newton/GGN(matrix-free O(M) Hvp,复用 M(T) 带状 LU);并把 reduced-Hessian 惯性/谱当卡死类型路由器。
verdicts.prior_art_summary: 标准 MINCO(Wang/Han/Gao, GCOPTER, IEEE T-RO 2022, arXiv:2103.00190)在平坦消元后的 (q,T) 上用的是 **L-BFGS(一阶拟牛顿)+ 解析梯度**,不是求解器级二阶。它确实利用 M(T)c=b 的带状结构和"Hessian 随时间幂线性"这一性质,但只用于解析地算【梯度】,不构造 Newton/GGN 步。最接近"用到内层 Hessian 结构"的是双层(bilevel)系:Sun et al. "Fast UAV Trajectory Optimization Using Bilevel Optimization With Analytical Gradients" 及 "Simultaneous Spatial and Temporal Assignment ..."(arXiv:2211.15902)——内层空间系数当等式约束 QP(闭式/Hessian 线性于时间幂),外层时间用解析梯度的一阶方法;近期 SABO 类工作同思路。真正的求解器级二阶轨迹优化是 iLQR/DDP(Tassa 等;AL-iLQR;multi-shooting DDP, arXiv:2307.12606)——DDP 二阶收敛,但作用在**全状态-控制空间、按时间步 quadratize 值函数**,结构上与"对 (q,T) 平坦消元变量做缩并 Hessian"完全不同。直接对 MINCO (q,T) 缩并问题做 matrix-free O(M) reduced-Hessian Newton/GGN、复用非对称 M(T) 带状 LF 的 Hvp,未检索到任何先验;把 reduced-Hessian 惯性/λ_min 当跨层卡死路由器,亦无先验(IPOPT/SQP 的惯性修正是加 δI 正则保下降,不是读谱仲裁分支)。
verdicts.closest_overlap: 最直接威胁 F2:(a) GCOPTER/MINCO 已把 (q,T) 平坦消元 + 带状 M(T) 结构用于解析梯度,(b) bilevel-analytic-gradient 系(2211.15902)已经利用内层 QP/Hessian 结构。两者都"吃到"了同样的结构,但都停在外层一阶;DDP/iLQR 提供了二阶但在错误的空间(全状态-控制,非 (q,T) 缩并)。S5/F1(惯性当路由器)几乎无重叠。
verdicts.what_survives: 剥掉先验后仍存活:① 在 MINCO 平坦消元 (q,T) 缩并问题上做**求解器级二阶**(reduced-Hessian Newton/GGN,而非 L-BFGS/解析梯度一阶)——无直接先验,标准实现一律 L-BFGS;② matrix-free O(M) Hvp 的**具体装配**(复用非对称 M(T) 的单次带状 LU 正向+已有 solve_adjoint 转置解 + 段局部 dM/dT, d²M/dT²)——未见;③ S5/F1 把 reduced-Hessian 惯性/λ_min 升格为**跨层卡死类型路由器**(数值鞍 vs 拓扑困 vs 动力学不可行 → 逃逸/翻类/重定时)——完全存活,与 IPOPT/SQP 惯性正则正交。诚实削弱:GGN+Pearlmutter Hvp+带状预条件各自经典,bilevel 系已用内层 Hessian 结构算梯度,且 O(M) 优势只在大 M 显现(部署 M≤12 时与一阶差距小)——所以"二阶可行"这点的工程增量有限,真正的卖点退化为"惯性谱当路由器"这一无先验机制。

verdicts.target: F3 (FLÈCHE: 平坦消元 KKT 多项式系统全实根枚举 → "此同伦类无可行稳定点" 认证不可行判定,严格放弃 cell 而非超时)
verdicts.prior_art_summary: 数值代数几何用同伦延拓枚举多项式规划 KKT/临界点的"全部解",从而全局求解并认证全局最优,是成熟方向:Lindberg/Rodriguez 等 "A polyhedral homotopy algorithm for computing critical points of polynomial programs" (arXiv 2302.04117, 2023) 明确"find all critical points, and therefore globally solve, polynomial optimization problems";HomotopyContinuation.jl 提供对每个返回解的区间认证(certification);通用 NAG(Bertini/PHCpack)可数清全部复解、检验无实解,从而给出"无实可行临界点/无解"的完备性认证(AMS Notices 2023 "Polynomial Systems, Homotopy Continuation, and Applications" 综述了这类不可行/完备枚举用法)。轨迹优化侧 KKT+同伦也有人做:ZIB "Newton's Method for Global Free Flight Trajectory Optimization" (arXiv 2302.04748) 用离散图枚举候选同伦类 + 连续 Newton-KKT 求局部最优。但该工作把同伦类用于"枚举候选+热启动",并不对单个同伦类做"全实根→无可行稳定点"的认证不可行宣判。多次定向检索(spline/MINCO 轨迹 + 全实根 KKT 枚举 + 证明某同伦类无稳定点 + 放弃 cell)均未命中,网络检索助手明确"does not appear in the current research literature"。
verdicts.closest_overlap: 威胁 F3。最近重叠 = arXiv 2302.04117 + HomotopyContinuation.jl 认证 + NAG 通用"数清全部解→认证无实解"能力:它们已把"KKT 多项式系统全(实)根枚举 → 完备性 → 认证(无)解"这条数学链做成熟。F3 的纯数学内核(全实根枚举给认证不可行)正是这条已有链,因此该内核非新——F3 自己也已诚实承认"延拓本身经典"。
verdicts.what_survives: 剥掉先验后,F3 的数学内核(全实根 KKT 枚举 → 完备性 → 认证不可行)被判定为已有,不算新。存活的残差只剩两条且都偏"应用绑定/集成"而非"机制":(a) 把该不可行证书具体焊在 MINCO 平坦消元后的 per-cell KKT 多项式结构上,当作"此同伦类(cell)无可行稳定点"的认证放弃判据(替代超时启发式)——未见先验在 spline/MINCO 规划里这样用,但属"已知技术换载体";(b) 把该证书当作惯性路由触发的逃逸算子的输入(B5 闭环)。注意 (b) 的真新点(读 reduced-Hessian 惯性来仲裁/派逃逸)其实属于 F1/S5 残差,不是 F3 本身;F3 单独剥离后,真正独占的新意很薄,基本退化为"把成熟 NAG 不可行认证接到 MINCO cell 上"的工程性贡献。

verdicts.target: [paper] EGO-Planner-v2 + TRUST-Planner (UTF-MINCO) + Bubble Planner — 拓扑搜索 + 类内并行 MINCO 优化的现状,核 D1 "这就是 EGO-v2" 攻击对 FULCRUM
verdicts.prior_art_summary:
三篇都是 ZJU-FAST 系 MINCO 谱系的一阶规划器:
(1) EGO-Planner-v2 (ZJU, arXiv:2008.08835 的 v2 演进): 用 MINCO 替 B-spline,quasi-Newton **L-BFGS 一阶**求解,软障碍形变(deform shape to avoid obstacles)+ 速度/加速度/jerk 幅值约束,无拓扑枚举、无认证安全。
(2) TRUST-Planner (arXiv:2508.14610, 2025): **正是"拓扑搜索 + 类内并行 MINCO 优化"的最新最强体现**。前端 DEV-PRM 探多条时空 homotopy 拓扑路径,后端 **UTF-MINCO(uniform terminal-free MINCO)+ DDF**,解析梯度、**线性时空复杂度、10ms 级**;维护一个 priority queue of trajectory branches(每条属不同时空 homotopy 类),主支导航 + 子支应急,环境变化时快速切换——这就是"按拓扑类并行/增量优化 + 卡死时切类"的机制。但**仅软惩罚(fmax 平滑 max(x,0)),96% 成功率经验值,无任何形式化安全界、无 conformal、无风险预算**。
(3) Bubble Planner (arXiv:2202.12177): corridor-constrained MINCO(GCOPTER 家族),overlapping spheres 安全走廊 + receding horizon corridors,一阶无约束优化。
GCOPTER/MINCO 原型(arXiv:2103.00190): MINCO 设计为无约束控制代价最小化器,约束消元 + 一阶优化。
**共同点**:全部一阶(L-BFGS/解析梯度),软惩罚或硬走廊,无人读 reduced-Hessian 谱、无求解器级二阶 MINCO、无同伦延拓不可行性证书、无 HOCBF 前向不变性证书。
verdicts.closest_overlap: 主撞 FULCRUM 的"载体/脚手架"层 + D1 攻击面。TRUST-Planner 几乎逐字命中"拓扑搜索 + 类内并行 MINCO 优化 + 卡死切支":多 homotopy 分支并行管理、按拓扑类组织、deadlock 时切到子支。EGO-v2 命中"MINCO + 一阶软形变"。因此 D1 "这就是 EGO-v2/TRUST" 攻击对 FULCRUM 的【外壳】(cell-per-topology + 并行类内优化 + 切支恢复)成立。但对 FULCRUM 的【核心 4 残差 F1-F4】(solver 内部的二阶 + 谱路由 + 认证不可行 + CBF 不变性)无重叠。
verdicts.what_survives:
剥掉 EGO-v2/TRUST/Bubble 后,FULCRUM 的四条残差全部存活,因为它们都是 solver 内部机制,而先验全是一阶软惩罚外壳:
- F2(求解器级二阶 MINCO):先验 100% 一阶(EGO-v2=L-BFGS,TRUST=解析梯度,Bubble/GCOPTER=无约束一阶)。FULCRUM 复用非对称 M(T) 的单次带状 LU + 段局部 dM/dT,d²M/dT² 得 O(M) matrix-free Hvp,做求解器级二阶 MINCO——无先验。诚实保留:GGN+Pearlmutter+带状预条件各自经典,O(M) 仅大 M 显现(M≤12 部署退化为常数优势)。
- F1(惯性即路由器):无先验读自身 reduced-Hessian 惯性谱在线分型"为何卡死"并派结构不同的恢复;TRUST 只是 solver-flag 式切支,不读谱仲裁。
- F3(FLÈCHE 认证拓扑不可行):先验 deadlock = 软失败/超时/换支;FULCRUM 用平坦消元 KKT 多项式全实根延拓给"此同伦类无可行稳定点"证书,严格放弃 cell 而非超时——无先验。
- F4(FI-MINCO per-segment quintic-Bernstein HOCBF 前向不变性):先验是软惩罚或走廊硬约束,无逐段 HOCBF 不变性证书当 accept-gate + DYN_INFEASIBLE 路由输入。
注意:D1 攻击确实削掉了 FULCRUM 的"拓扑并行优化是新的"这一【框架级】卖点——这点必须让位 TRUST-Planner(2025),不能再当卖点。FULCRUM 的新颖性必须收紧到"在已有拓扑/MINCO 脚手架内,把求解器从一阶升级为带谱诊断+认证恢复的二阶机器",而非"我们发明了拓扑+并行"。

verdicts.target: S1 — conformal quantile as a tradeable/allocatable dual resource (per-agent budget α_i → distribution-free radius r_i=Q_{1-α_i}), not a single global margin; planner objective = the certificate
verdicts.prior_art_summary: The closest prior art is "Conformal Prediction in The Loop: A Feedback-Based Uncertainty Model for Trajectory Optimization" (arXiv:2510.16376, Oct 2025), which presents Fb-CP-IRA: it explicitly extends Ono & Williams (2008) Iterative Risk Allocation to feedback conformal prediction. The allocated resource IS the distribution-free conformal quantile radius C^(1-α_τ)=Quantile_{1-α_τ}(R^(1..K),∞), the total risk budget α is split across the horizon under ∑_τ α_τ ≤ α − ∑βτ, and the split is OPTIMIZED via the classic IRA upper/lower two-stage iteration (tighten inactive constraints, reallocate slack to active ones — i.e. the dual/shadow-price reallocation). The paper even states the radius is non-increasing in α_τ, which is exactly the "tradeable" budget↔margin relationship S1 claims. This is distribution-free conformal, NOT Gaussian chance-constraint — precisely the distinction S1 uses to differentiate itself from Ono-Williams. Supporting prior: classic Ono-Williams IRA already allocates a global risk budget across per-obstacle AND per-time chance constraints via Lagrange-multiplier reallocation (the "tradeable resource" idea); "Risk-Bounded Multi-Agent Visual Navigation via IRA" (arXiv:2509.08157) does explicit per-agent risk budgets under a global constraint with iterative reallocation; "Bridging Conformal Prediction and Scenario Optimization" (arXiv:2603.19396) distributes a conformal risk budget across coordinates/steps/constraints (fixed union bound, not optimized); H-PRAP (arXiv:2507.11920) routes per-obstacle but allocates compute, not the conformal quantile. Per-obstacle conformal-radius budgeting summing to a global budget also appears in MPC navigation work.
verdicts.closest_overlap: Threatens S1 directly. Fb-CP-IRA (2510.16376) overlaps on every core element of S1: (a) the allocated quantity is the distribution-free conformal quantile radius r=Q_{1-α}; (b) α is a budget split across constraints and traded, not a single global margin; (c) the split is optimized via IRA dual/shadow-price reallocation; (d) explicitly distribution-free, not Gaussian chance-constraint — the exact contrast S1 draws.
verdicts.what_survives: The pure "conformal quantile as a tradeable, optimized, distribution-free resource budget (not a single global margin)" claim is published (Fb-CP-IRA, 2510.16376). What is NOT literally shown: (1) per-AGENT decomposition of the conformal budget — Fb-CP-IRA allocates across TIME with the joint obstacle state as one entity; but classic IRA already allocates per-obstacle, so marrying per-agent conformal radii is incremental, not conceptually new. (2) The framing "λ price unit = makespan per unit conformal quantile" and "planner objective IS the certificate" is standard Lagrangian shadow-pricing dressed in CP language. The genuinely surviving novelty does NOT live in S1 alone — it lives in the COUPLING that S2 claims (the single price λ simultaneously reallocating per-agent budget AND selecting/flipping the spacetime winding/homotopy class at certified breakpoints λ_k, emitting a (time, certified-risk) Pareto staircase). That budget↔topology unification is what no prior here does; S1's standalone "tradeable conformal quantile" is essentially done.

verdicts.target: S2 (STRIDE): single conformal risk price λ simultaneously (a) reallocates per-agent ε budget AND (b) selects the spatiotemporal winding/passing-side topology class; λ-continuum breakpoints λ_k are certified go-vs-yield switches → native (time, certified-risk) Pareto staircase. Budget reallocation and topology flip are ONE mechanism.
verdicts.prior_art_summary: Prior art splits the claim into two mature-but-SEPARATE mechanisms. (1) Topology selection: Topology-Driven Parallel Trajectory Optimization / T-MPC++ (de Groot et al., arXiv:2401.06021, 2024) and winding-number-in-cost MPC enumerate distinct passing/winding (H-signature, winding-number, UVD) classes IN PARALLEL and then execute "the feasible trajectory with the lowest cost" — selection is enumerate-and-pick, not a traded dual price; no certified breakpoint = homotopy switch, no coupling to a risk budget (confirmed by reading the project page). (2) Risk-budget reallocation: Iterative Risk Allocation (Ono & Williams, ~2008; Blackmore-Ono chance-constrained path planning) uses a two-stage / dual scheme to reallocate per-constraint (per-agent/per-step) risk bound to reduce conservatism — but it operates WITHIN a fixed feasible region/topology and never selects passing side or winding class. Budget-aware topology selection appears in unrelated domains (BAMAS multi-agent-system topology, arXiv:2511.21572; topological portfolio selection) but not as a single certified dual price in motion planning. No source was found where ONE Lagrangian/dual price both reallocates per-agent risk budget and flips the passing-side/winding homotopy class, with λ-breakpoints proven to be the go/yield switch generating a certified time-vs-risk Pareto staircase.
verdicts.closest_overlap: Threatens S2 directly. Two partial overlaps: (i) winding-number-weighted MPC / T-MPC++ — a cost term over winding classes CAN flip passing topology as a weight changes, overlapping the "weight → topology switch" half; (ii) Iterative Risk Allocation (Ono-Williams) — a dual/two-stage variable that reallocates per-agent risk budget, overlapping the "price → budget reallocation" half. Neither does both; neither certifies the breakpoint as the switch.
verdicts.what_survives: The unification kernel survives and is the real novelty: that the SAME scalar price λ — denominated in conformal quantile units (makespan / unit conformal quantile) — is simultaneously the per-agent budget reallocator AND the winding-class selector, and that its λ-continuum breakpoints λ_k are CERTIFIED go-vs-yield homotopy switches yielding a native (time, certified-risk) Pareto staircase rather than a single trajectory. Prior art has each half but never collapses them into one mechanism, and never certifies the breakpoint-as-switch. Caveats that erode the margin: (1) the "weight on a winding-number cost flips passing side" behavior is implicitly known in T-MPC-style work, so the topology-via-scalar half is not itself surprising; (2) the conformal-quantile units (S1) and enumeration-decoupled safety (S3) do the heavy lifting to make the price meaningful — S2 alone, stripped of S1/S4, is "we noticed risk-allocation duals and topology selection are the same knob," which must be demonstrated (provable breakpoint structure + Pareto staircase) to be defensible, not asserted.

verdicts.target: STRIDE S4 — min-risk total-function planner: codomain always (trajectory, ρ); "stuck"=finite scalar min-risk>ε (not solver flag); returns λ→∞ certified recovery class (max-min-clearance yield + z-climb to invariant set) + bound; recovery constructively non-empty
verdicts.prior_art_summary: The three mechanism-components of S4 are each established prior art. (1) Never-infeasible-by-backup: FASTER (Tordesillas & How, ICRA 2019 / arXiv:1903.03558) and gatekeeper (Agrawal, Chen, Panagou, arXiv:2508.09963 / IEEE T-RO 2024) both GUARANTEE the planner always has a feasible, safe backup/committed trajectory ending in a safe invariant set — the planner never returns "infeasible," and the recovery (brake-to-stop / drive-to-invariant-set, incl. holding/"stay") is non-empty by construction. (2) Min-risk scalar fallback when trapped: CVaR-constrained motion planning (Hakobyan & Yang, IEEE T-RO 2019, "Risk-Aware Motion Planning and Control Using CVaR-Constrained Optimization") explicitly states that when the robot is trapped, gradually decreasing the CVaR risk parameter yields a minimum-risk escape plan — i.e., a graded scalar-risk fallback returning a trajectory (with a risk value) when no fully-safe path exists. (3) Always-returns totality: Hamilton-Jacobi / least-restrictive safety filters (Fridovich-Keil/Tomlin lineage; survey "The Safety Filter," Annual Reviews 2024) always output a minimally-invasive control, switching to a certified-safe action at the reachable-set boundary. So "planner that never reports no-solution + a min-risk escape when stuck + a constructively-existing recovery" is collectively done.
verdicts.closest_overlap: Threatens S4. Closest single overlap: CVaR-constrained planning's "decrease α to get a minimum-risk escape when trapped" = S4's "stuck = min-risk scalar, return recovery"; and gatekeeper/FASTER's always-available safe-backup-to-invariant-set = S4's never-infeasible totality + constructively non-empty recovery (incl. "stay") + z-climb-to-invariant-set primitive. Overlap is on the core idea that the planner is total and degrades to a graded/min-risk fallback instead of failing.
verdicts.what_survives: Mechanism is not new; the surviving residual is the PACKAGING/SEMANTICS: a single uniform codomain (trajectory, ρ) where ρ is a DISTRIBUTION-FREE CONFORMAL-certified risk scalar (ε_cls+ε_pred), so "infeasible" is replaced by a certified bound measured on the SAME conformal certificate that bounds the nominal path — not a heuristic CVaR α-knob (Hakobyan/Yang give no distribution-free finite-sample guarantee) and not gatekeeper's binary safe/unsafe committed-trajectory (no graded certified risk number). I.e., the novel-if-anything bit is binding the total-function/min-risk-fallback to the conformal ε certificate and emitting a per-round certified scalar as the universal output, rather than the recovery mechanism (z-climb/yield/stay are standard backup primitives) or the "never report infeasible" framing themselves. This is a framing/integration residual of modest strength, not a new safety mechanism.

verdicts.target: F4 — FI-MINCO per-segment quintic-Bernstein HOCBF continuous-time forward-invariance certificate for moving spheres (accept-gate + DYN_INFEASIBLE routing input)
verdicts.prior_art_summary: Three overlapping bodies of work. (1) MADER (Tordesillas & How, IEEE T-RO 2021, arXiv 2010.11061): represents each trajectory segment by its Bernstein/MINVO control-point convex hull (outer polyhedron) and adds a separating plane per obstacle interval as a decision variable, yielding a CONTINUOUS-TIME (not sampled) collision-free guarantee against MOVING obstacles/agents — exactly the per-segment, Bernstein-hull, dynamic-obstacle continuous-time safety certificate, but enforced via separating-hyperplane clearance rather than a CBF differential inequality. The broader Bezier/B-spline convex-hull planning literature (FASTER, EGO-Planner, relative-Bernstein arXiv:1909.10219) does the same continuous-time-via-control-points trick. (2) HOCBF-on-Bezier: arXiv 2502.01009 (2025, FoV-CBF Bezier MPC) and arXiv 2510.03504 (multi-robot Bezier-HOCBF) define HOCBFs ON piecewise Bezier segments with forward-invariance, but explicitly enforce them only at SAMPLED time steps ('imposing HOCBF constraints for all times is intractable...applies constraints at sampled time stamps') — i.e., NOT continuous-time/hull-certified. (3) Bernstein/SOS barrier certification: Bernstein-coefficient non-negativity testing (arXiv:2309.10675), Bernstein stochastic barrier functions (arXiv:2506.09164), semi-algebraic/Positivstellensatz CBF verification (arXiv:2209.00081) certify polynomial barrier non-negativity via Bernstein control points or SOS — but for CBF synthesis/verification over state space, not online certification of a planned spline segment's HOCBF inequality vs a moving sphere.
verdicts.closest_overlap: Threatens F4. Closest is MADER (arXiv:2010.11061): per-segment Bernstein/MINVO convex-hull, continuous-time, moving-obstacle safety certificate used as an accept/recheck gate — overlaps on every axis of 'per-segment Bernstein continuous-time safety for moving spheres' EXCEPT it certifies clearance via separating planes, not a (HO)CBF forward-invariance differential inequality. Secondary overlap: arXiv:2502.01009 / 2510.03504 already pair HOCBF with piecewise Bezier segments and forward-invariance, but only at sampled times.
verdicts.what_survives: After removing MADER and the Bezier-HOCBF papers, the surviving novel sliver is narrow but nonzero: (a) certifying the HOCBF DIFFERENTIAL INEQUALITY ITSELF (h-dot + alpha(h) >= 0, high relative degree vs a moving sphere) as a closed-form CONTINUOUS-TIME certificate by evaluating it along a quintic MINCO segment as a polynomial-in-time, converting to Bernstein (reusing C2B/control_points already in the pipeline) and checking control-point non-negativity — no direct hit found that certifies the CBF inequality (rather than clearance/distance) per planned spline segment online against a moving obstacle; prior continuous-time hull work certifies clearance (MADER), prior HOCBF-on-Bezier samples in time. (b) The genuinely distinctive integration: the SAME certificate is reused as a typed DYN_INFEASIBLE classifier feeding the cross-layer inertia-router (F1/F3) for structured recovery — that dual accept-gate/router role is novel as integration but is NOT a standalone safety-theory contribution. Caveat: the safety GUARANTEE delivered (continuous-time collision-freeness vs moving spheres on a Bernstein-represented spline) adds little beyond MADER; the HOCBF reformulation mainly buys a margin-decay-rate semantics and the routing hook, not stronger safety.

synthesis.stride_residual:
S1=死(唯一 collides):Fb-CP-IRA(arXiv 2510.16376, 2025-10)把 Ono-Williams IRA 扩成 feedback conformal——被分配资源就是 distribution-free conformal quantile 半径、按预算拆分并用 IRA 两阶段对偶/影子价重分配、明确非高斯,正是 S1 用来区分自己的那条线。"conformal quantile 当可交易分布无关预算(非单一全局 margin)" 已发表;per-agent 分解相对 classic-IRA per-obstacle 只是增量;"λ 单位=makespan/单位 quantile"+"planner 目标即证书" 是 CP 外衣下标准 Lagrangian 影子定价。独立卖点死,仅可当 S2 喂入。
S2=存活(承重):跨 T-MPC++/braids/IRA/GCS/S2 专项 5 条 partial 一致认定的真新核——同一价格 λ(conformal-quantile 单位)同时 (a) per-agent 间重分配 conformal 预算 (b) 选/翻 spacetime winding 类,λ_k 断点被认证为抢行vs让行切换 → 原生 (时间,认证风险) Pareto 阶梯。无先验把"预算重分配"与"拓扑翻转"坍缩成一个被定价、断点被认证的机制。强条件:须证出断点结构+阶梯定理,否则退化为"两个已知对偶是同一旋钮"(IRA+constrained-MDP duality 的 re-skin)。
S3=部分:解耦本身被 T-MPC 架构性预占(枚举完备性 vs per-class 可行已分离),"我们发明解耦"framing 须弃;存活=给已知解耦补 executed-quintic 上 distribution-free conformal-tube + Bernstein-hull 事后证书,并证安全独立于枚举完备性(不全只损 anytime gap)。残留:更广 CP-crowd-nav 轴本批未查。
S4=部分(弱):机制全死(FASTER/gatekeeper 永不 infeasible+recovery 非空、CVaR 降 α 取 min-risk、HJ least-restrictive filter);存活仅 packaging=统一陪域 (traj,ρ) 且 ρ 绑同一 ε 证书的分布无关 conformal 标量。框架/集成残差,弱。
S5=部分:meta-claim"首个读谱当路由器"被 IPOPT feasibility-restoration + 负曲率逃逸方向 refute,弃;存活=cross-layer planner-SEMANTIC 路由 targets(读 reduced-Hessian 谱判型后派 逃逸/翻 winding 类/重定时——优化器内只在单次连续解里 regularize/换步,拓扑并行 planner 又不读谱)。modest 可辩护,claim 限"新路由 targets/语义"。
synthesis.fulcrum_residual:
F1=部分(=S5):中央卖点的 meta-pattern(惯性当路由器)已 dead;存活同 S5 的 planner-semantic 路由 targets。TRUST-Planner 只 solver-flag 式切支、不读谱仲裁,故 targets 仍清白但 modest,非干净新机制。
F2=部分(弱):对 MINCO 平坦消元 (q,T) 缩并问题做 solver-级二阶(reduced-Hessian Newton/GGN,标准实现一律 L-BFGS)+ O(M) matrix-free Hvp 具体装配(复用非对称 M(T) 单次带状 LU 正向 + 已有 solve_adjoint 转置 + 段局部 dM/dT,d²M/dT²)——无直接先验。但其自承诚实削弱成立:GGN+Pearlmutter+带状预条件各自经典,O(M) 仅大 M 显现,部署 M≤12 退化为常数优势 ⇒ "二阶可行" 工程增量有限,真卖点回落到 F1(已 dead meta)。
F3=部分(弱/近死):纯数学内核(全实根 KKT 枚举→完备→认证不可行)被 NAG/Bertini/HomotopyContinuation.jl/2302.04117 判已有,死;存活仅 (a) 焊到 MINCO per-cell KKT 当认证放弃判据(已知技术换载体)(b) 当 F1 逃逸算子输入——而 (b) 的真新点属 F1 不属 F3。独占新意极薄,基本退化为工程接线。置信最低(0.6)。
F4=部分(窄):MADER 已做 per-segment Bernstein 连续时间动障安全(但用 separating-plane 证 clearance 非 CBF 微分不等式;Bezier-HOCBF 只在采样时刻)。存活窄核=用 quintic→Bernstein 控制点非负性把 HOCBF 微分不等式本身当闭式连续时间证书(复用 C2B/control_points)+ 兼当 DYN_INFEASIBLE 路由输入。诚实:相对 MADER 安全增益甚微,主要买到 margin 衰减率语义 + 路由钩子,非更强安全。
killed: S1 独立残差(conformal quantile 当可交易/可优化/分布无关风险预算)— collides Fb-CP-IRA arXiv 2510.16376(2025-10)已发表,弃当独立卖点(仅留作 S2 喂入)
框架级:spacetime winding 类枚举 + 类内并行优化 + min-cost/切支选择 — T-MPC++(2401.06021)/Mavrogiannis-Knepper braids/TRUST-Planner(2508.14610,2025)全占,STRIDE 与 FULCRUM 都须让位,只能引用当载体
spacetime 全局最优 / anytime / 认证间隙下界 — GCS 谱系(ST-GCS/GCS*/IxG*/ST-RRT*)做尽,弃当 contribution
S5/F1 的 meta-claim「首个读 Hessian/惯性谱当路由器」— IPOPT feasibility-restoration + 负曲率逃逸方向 refute,弃此 framing(只保「新路由 targets」)
S3 的「我们发明 枚举完备性/安全 解耦」framing — T-MPC 架构性已有,降级为「给已知解耦加分布无关证书」
F3 纯数学内核(全实根 KKT→认证不可行)— NAG/HomotopyContinuation.jl 已有,弃当机制贡献(仅留载体接线)
S4 的 recovery 机制本体 + 「永不报 infeasible」全函数性 — FASTER/gatekeeper/CVaR/HJ filter 已有,只保「绑 conformal ε 的统一陪域」packaging
survivors: S2 统一核(承重 marquee):同一 conformal-quantile-单位价格 λ 同时重分配 per-agent 风险预算 AND 翻 spacetime winding 类,λ_k 断点=认证 抢行/让行 切换 → (时间,认证风险) Pareto 阶梯;送证目标=断点结构+阶梯定理
S3:executed-quintic 上 distribution-free conformal-tube + Bernstein-hull 事后风险证书,且可证安全独立于 winding 枚举完备性(不全只损 anytime gap)
S5/F1:cross-layer planner-SEMANTIC 惯性路由——读 reduced-Hessian 谱判型(数值鞍/此 winding 拓扑困/动力学不可行)后派结构不同的 planning-层恢复(逃逸/翻 winding 类/重定时);claim 限「新路由 targets/语义」
F2:O(M) matrix-free reduced-Hessian Hvp(复用非对称 M(T) 带状 LU + solve_adjoint + 段局部 dM/dT,d²M/dT²)使 MINCO (q,T) 缩并问题上 solver-级二阶可行——无直接先验(标准 L-BFGS);弱(O(M) 部署 M≤12 不显)
F4(窄):用 quintic→Bernstein 控制点非负性认证 HOCBF 微分不等式本身为连续时间证书(对运动球)+ 兼当 DYN_INFEASIBLE 路由输入——相对 MADER clearance 证书真新增量仅在 CBF-不等式语义
(弱尾,低优先送证)S4 packaging:统一陪域 (traj,ρ)、ρ 绑同一 conformal ε 证书;F3 载体绑定:NAG 不可行证书接 MINCO per-cell 当认证放弃判据
synthesis.sharpest_novelty: 同一个以 conformal-quantile 计价的对偶价格 λ(单位=makespan/单位 conformal tube 半径),在一个连续 quintic 全函数 planner 里同时充当 per-agent 分布无关风险预算的重分配器 与 spacetime winding/抢让侧拓扑类的选择器,其 λ-连续统断点 λ_k 是被认证的 抢行vs让行 同伦切换,从而原生输出 (时间,认证风险) 的 Pareto 阶梯而非单条轨迹——没有任何先验把「风险预算重分配」与「拓扑翻转」坍缩成同一个被定价、断点被认证的机制(IRA/Fb-CP-IRA 只重分配不翻拓扑;T-MPC/braids 只枚举选拓扑、不定价、不认证断点;constrained-MDP duality 的 价格→切换+Pareto 在离散 MDP、非连续 winding、非 conformal)。
remaining_risks: S2 承重却高风险:若证不出 λ_k 断点结构+Pareto 阶梯定理,即退化为「IRA 风险重分配 + T-MPC 拓扑选择 是同一旋钮」的 re-skin;「权重翻 passing side」半边在 T-MPC 式工作已隐含
constrained-MDP / dual CC-SSP(2302.13115)独立给出「风险价格→离散策略切换+cost/risk Pareto 前沿」,须把 连续 spacetime winding + conformal 与 离散 MDP 对偶锐利区分,否则 S2 的「断点+Pareto」读作已知
S2 依赖 per-agent conformal 预算重分配,而 Fb-CP-IRA + classic-IRA 已大体预占该半;若审稿把 coupling-to-topology 读成平凡组合,S2 边际坍塌
S3 的 conformal-tube 安全 与更广 CP-for-crowd-nav 轴(Interaction-aware CP 2502.06221;Conformal Risk Control HRI 2603.10392)本批 13 裁决未查——Bernstein-hull executed-path 事后证书是否被预占需补搜
S5/F1 路由若 framing 失误(claim「首个用惯性」)将正撞 IPOPT feasibility-restoration + 负曲率方法;只能 claim「planner-层新路由 targets」
F2 的 O(M)/solver-级二阶 在 M≤12 部署无实益,可能被判增量工程;需一个 O(M) 真显现的部署/规模 regime 或重定价值叙事
F3 数学内核已死仅余载体接线;F4 相对 MADER 安全增益甚微——两者单独都可能不过顶会新颖性门槛
未独立核实 STRIDE/FULCRUM 自称复用的代码原语(solve_adjoint / C2B / 非对称 M(T) 带状 LU)是否真存在且能支撑 O(M) Hvp 与 Bernstein HOCBF——本批为纯先验比对,未验证实现可行性
synthesis.recommendation: 撞车后 STRIDE 更稳,但条件性强。(1) 深度而非标签:STRIDE 只吃一个 collides(S1),却保住两候选里唯一跨所有撞车轴都清白的干净新机制 S2(价格即统一的 预算重分配器+拓扑选择器、断点被认证);FULCRUM 四条全 partial(无 collides)看似稳,但中央卖点 F1 的 meta-pattern(惯性当路由器)已被 IPOPT/负曲率 refute、框架(拓扑+并行 MINCO)被 TRUST-Planner(2025)拿走,余 F2(O(M) 部署 M≤12 不显)/F3(数学内核死)/F4(相对 MADER 增益微)各自偏弱,坍缩为「已让出脚手架内的 solver 内部工程增量」,无干净新机制。(2) 对齐主线:pivot 后主论文=planner 无关的认证语义风险安全层,STRIDE 存活核(S2 conformal 风险定价 + S3 executed-path 认证风险)正落在主线 conformal 证书推力上;FULCRUM 存活核(solver 内二阶/惯性路由/HOCBF)属 side-paper(MINCO planner)范畴,与已「基本冻结」的规划器载体定位一致。(3) 共享项不分胜负:惯性路由 S5==F1 在两者以同等(modest)强度存活,不构成区分;区分项是 STRIDE-独有 S2(干净机制) vs FULCRUM-独有 F2/F3/F4(均弱)。诚实保留:STRIDE 的优势完全押在 S2 断点/Pareto 定理上——若证不出,STRIDE 退回与 FULCRUM 同级的 integration-only,届时 FULCRUM 那几条 modest-but-real 的 solver 残差(尤其 F2 无直接先验、F4 的 CBF-不等式连续时间证书)反而是更低天花板但更不易再撞的退路。优先级:先押 Wave4 证 S2 定理;并行补搜 S3 的 CP-crowd-nav 轴;F1/S5 与 F4 当第二梯队;S1 弃、F3 仅留载体接线。
